sequential_and_pool_throughput.basis: valid outputs completed per elapsed wall second; same derivative, source, seed and backend; cancellation excluded

interpretation.throughput: Four workers yielded about1.012x valid completion rate on2CPUquota; no useful parallel speedup established.
interpretation.parity: control01 repeat hashes match across botharms. Controls02-06 vary between unchanged baseline repeats and between derivative repeats, so cross-arm hash differences are not attribution evidence. General bitwise parity remains unestablished.
interpretation.cancellation: Actual normal CLI runs frozen ThreadPoolExecutor, disabling derivative main-thread-only SIGTERM handler. Chrome also starts its own session separate from worker. Profiler SIGKILL was required; cleanup passed only with profiler intervention. Production cancellation repair and focused real-Chrome retest required before GPU allocation.

next_decision: Repair real CLI signal dispatch and independently-sessioned browser cleanup; rerun stablecontrol01 plus knownslowcancel only, then approved finite GPU pilot.
